verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe got HTTP 200 from a public, keyless OpenAPI document at /api/v3/openapi, with the "openapi" key present. The documented auth, rate-limit and idempotency details are sourced from that same spec URL, so a machine-readable spec is directly downloadable. missing for 10: independent corroboration of the spec's completeness (the probe's marker check found registered-agent endpoints absent, which conflicts with the probe's own description of them being included).
